_comment: ARC-AGI-1 with bands, URM recipe at the URM global batch (2026-10-18): as arc1_bands.json, plus URM ACT (q_head on the prefix token, halt when q_halt > 0, exploration 0.1, loss + 0.5 BCE(q_halt, solved)) and a global batch of 768 lanes as 24 micro-batches of 32 (each its own lanes, carries offloaded to pinned CPU memory between segments). Dense 30x30 canvas (no packing). Checkpoints every 10,000 steps without the carry (28 GB); a resume starts fresh lanes. Evaluation (identity version, no voting) every 50 epochs at 64 puzzles per batch.
